cc:Work.dc:title: DeepSeek generation speed by model turn
cc:Work.dc:description: Documented November 4, 2026 engine decode rates. Discovery: 1.00, 0.80, 2.10, 1.60, 7.30, 7.60, 13.20 tokens per second. Confirmation: 1.44, 1.69, 6.40, 4.33, 5.76. Both panels share the same scale. Excludes loading, prompt processing and tool execution. Source: local-llms commit 0cdc3e2, docs/DEEPSEEK_SECURITY_LAB_TUNING.md; runs 20261104T035717.335244Z, 20261104T041839.082857Z. Typography: IBM Plex Sans and Space Grotesk, converted to vector outlines for consistent display without installed fonts.
